+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""L one-shot runner; grant, launch and numerical worker are separate actions.
+
+No default execution. This implementation-stage SOURCE ships only an inactive
+contract, never an issued scientific grant or approval. Artificial tests call
+the small numerical kernel directly with manually supplied fixtures.
+"""
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("local_L_controller", ROOT / "src/trotterlib/h4_local_control.py")
+c = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(c)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
+    group.add_argument("--check-contract", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--issue-grant", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--launch", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--worker", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--witness", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--seal", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--namespace", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--command-json")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        if args.check_contract:
+            c.validate_contract(c.read(args.check_contract))
+            print(json.dumps(dict(status="VALID_INACTIVE_OR_ACTIVE_CONTRACT_NOT_EXECUTION", science_calls=0)))
+        elif args.issue_grant:
+            c.require(args.seal is not None and args.namespace is not None, "SEAL_AND_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED")
+            c.issue_grant(args.issue_grant, args.seal, args.namespace)
+        elif args.launch:
+            c.launch(args.launch)
+        elif args.worker:
+            c.worker(args.worker)
+        else:
+            command = json.loads(args.command_json)
+            c.require(type(command) is list and command and all(type(x) is str for x in command), "WITNESS_COMMAND")
+            return c.witness(args.witness, command)
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error:
+        print("L_STOP: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""L-only authority, fixed budget and durable owned-process audit.
+
+Reuse frozen C fsync saves, hashes, locked nonrefundable budget and subreaper.
+No numerical backend import before worker authorization. No implicit grant.
+"""
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("L_reused_C_control", Path(__file__).with_name("h4_certificate_control.py"))
+C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(C)
+save, read, sha, digest, require, utc = C.save, C.read, C.sha, C.digest, C.require, C.utc
+LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
+ZERO = ("SCF", "FCI", "DF", "state_solve", "reference", "law_mean", "bias", "sampling", "RNG_replay", "compile", "N_G")
+
+
+def validate_contract(contract, *, active=False):
+    require(contract["kind"] == "H4_L_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT_V1", "L_CONTRACT_KIND")
+    require(contract["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_INPUT_DOMAIN")
+    require(contract["precision_bits"] == 128 and type(contract["precision_bits"]) is int, "L_FIXED_PRECISION")
+    require(contract["limits"] == LIMITS and all(type(x) is int for x in contract["limits"].values()), "L_FIXED_CALL_BUDGET")
+    require(contract["forbidden_calls"] == {k: 0 for k in ZERO}, "L_FORBIDDEN_BUDGET")
+    require(contract["expected_counts"] == dict(gates=148, bases=11, supports=324), "L_TARGET_COUNTS")
+    require(contract["automatic_retry"] is False and contract["mandatory_STOP"] is True, "L_RETRY_OR_STOP")
+    require(contract["formal_certificate_accepted"] is False and contract["N_G_authorized"] is False, "L_NO_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG")
+    require(contract["historical_compiler_target"] == "ORIGINAL_PROGRAM_UNCHANGED_MISSING_EVIDENCE", "L_K_TARGET_CHANGED")
+    if active:
+        require(all(contract[k] is True for k in ("execution_authorized", "grant_valid", "dispatch_enabled")), "L_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
+        require(contract.get("approval_file") and contract.get("approval_sha256"), "L_EXPLICIT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED")
+        require(sha(contract["approval_file"]) == contract["approval_sha256"], "L_APPROVAL_HASH")
+        approval = read(contract["approval_file"])
+        require(approval == dict(kind="L_EXPLICIT_NUMERICAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL", domain=contract["domain"],
+            technical_seal_sha256=contract["technical_seal_sha256"], namespace=contract["output_namespace"],
+            input_sha256=contract["input_sha256"], scope="DF_LOCAL_ONLY_FIXED128_NO_COMPILE_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG"), "L_APPROVAL_SCOPE")
+    return contract

+"""L local-gate production kernel, using frozen C ball/rational helpers.
+
+No molecular/reference/law/bias/sampling/compiler APIs. Real input is passed
+only by the separately authorized L worker. Artificial tests supply tiny data.
+All ideal gates use exact binary64 real parameters, never decimal substitution.

+from fractions import Fraction as Q
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import struct

+
+def _load(name, filename):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, Path(__file__).with_name(filename))
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+

+C = _load("local_frozen_C_ball", "h4_ball_evidence.py")
+P = _load("local_frozen_rational", "h4_enclosure_prototype.py")
+require = C.require
+PRECISION = 128
+LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
+
+
+def finite_float(value):
+    require(type(value) in (str, float, int), "FINITE_BINARY64_PARAMETER")
+    value = float(value)
+    require(math.isfinite(value), "NONFINITE_PARAMETER")
+    return value
+
+
+def matrix_hash(raw):
+    require(type(raw) is list and len(raw) in (2, 4) and all(type(r) is list and len(r) == len(raw) for r in raw), "LOCAL_MATRIX_SHAPE")
+    packed = []
+    for row in raw:
+        for pair in row:
+            require(type(pair) is list and len(pair) == 2 and all(type(x) in (int, float) for x in pair), "COMPLEX_BINARY64_PAIR")
+            packed.append(struct.pack("<dd", *(finite_float(x) for x in pair)))
+    return hashlib.sha256(b"".join(packed)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def ideal_gate(descriptor, *, inverse=False):
+    """Qiskit1.3 RZ and XXPlusYY definitions, including beta's endian sign."""
+    require(type(inverse) is bool, "INVERSE_FLAG")
+    name, params = descriptor["name"], descriptor["parameters"]
+    require(name in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy") and len(params) == (1 if name == "rz" else 2), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
+    theta = C.real(finite_float(params[0])) * (-1 if inverse else 1)
+    if name == "rz":
+        return C.acb_mat([[C.phase(-theta / 2), 0], [0, C.phase(theta / 2)]])
+    beta = C.real(finite_float(params[1]))
+    cos, sin = (theta / 2).cos(), (theta / 2).sin()
+    return C.acb_mat([[1, 0, 0, 0], [0, cos, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(-beta), 0],
+                      [0, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(beta), cos, 0], [0, 0, 0, 1]])
+
+
+def discrepancy(descriptor, raw, *, inverse=False):
+    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
+    matrix_hash(raw)
+    ideal = ideal_gate(descriptor, inverse=inverse)
+    require(len(raw) == ideal.nrows(), "DESCRIPTOR_MATRIX_DIMENSION")
+    bound = C.frobenius(C.matrix(raw) - ideal)
+    require(bound.is_finite() and bound.lower() >= 0, "UNPROVED_LOCAL_BOUND")
+    return C.dyadic(bound.upper())
+
+
+def product_bound(errors):
+    """Frozen rational telescoping, outward rounded at each fixed128 step.
+
+    Avoid exponentially growing denominators in long product bounds. Exact
+    two-factor rational composition precedes each Arb outward rounding.
+    """
+    require(all(type(x) is Q and x >= 0 for x in errors), "NONNEGATIVE_EXACT_BOUND")
+    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
+    bound = Q(0)
+    for error in errors:
+        exact = P.product_error_bound([Q(1), Q(1)], [bound, error])
+        bound = C.dyadic(C.real(exact).upper())
+    return bound
+
+
+def conjugation_bound(forward, inverse):
+    # ||F D J - U D U*|| <= f+i+f*i for any unitary diagonal D.
+    return product_bound([inverse, forward])
+
+
+def signed_controlled_identity(sign, *, controlled=True):
+    """Artificial/formal branch oracle: a system sign becomes relative phase."""
+    require(type(sign) is int and sign in (-1, 1) and type(controlled) is bool, "SIGNED_CONTROL_DOMAIN")
+    return dict(zero_branch=1, one_branch=sign) if controlled else dict(system_global_phase=sign)
+
+
+def coverage_ledger(records):
+    """Preserve aggregate C total; refuse unproved overlaps or cancellation."""
+    require(type(records) is list and records, "COVERAGE_REQUIRED")
+    seen, owners = set(), {}
+    for record in records:
+        require(set(record) == {"id", "covers", "bound_ref"}, "COVERAGE_SCHEMA")
+        require(type(record["id"]) is str and record["id"] not in seen, "DUPLICATE_COVERAGE_RECORD")
+        seen.add(record["id"])
+        covers = record["covers"]
+        require(type(covers) is list and covers and all(type(x) is str for x in covers)
+                and len(set(covers)) == len(covers) and bool(record["bound_ref"]), "MISSING_COVERAGE_OR_BOUND")
+        for primitive in covers:
+            owners.setdefault(primitive, []).append(record["id"])
+    overlap = {k: v for k, v in owners.items() if len(v) > 1}
+    required = {"bias_distance", "basis_reuse", "phase_accumulation", "pi_rounding", "local_forward", "local_inverse"}
+    missing = sorted(required - set(owners))
+    return dict(records=records, overlapping_primitives=overlap, uncovered_primitives=missing,
+                status="COMBINATION_BLOCKED" if overlap or missing else "DISJOINT_COVERAGE_ONLY_NO_ACCEPTANCE",
+                simple_addition_permitted=not overlap and not missing,

+
+def plan_from_saved(model, registry, *, artificial=False):

+    n = model["n_qubits"]
+    require(type(n) is int and n > 0, "MODEL_QUBITS")
+    gates, bases, supports = {}, {}, []
+    case_bases, block_counts = {}, {}
+    for method in ("PF", "PR"):
+        case = model["cases"][method]
+        case_bases[method] = set()
+        block_counts[method] = len(case["blocks"])
+        for item in case["blocks"] + case["components"]:
+            basis = item["basis"]
+            key = basis["basis_hash"]
+            operations = []
+            for op in basis["operations"]:
+                d = op["description"]
+                require(d["name"] in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy"), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
+                require(d["qubits"] == op["qubits"] and len(set(op["qubits"])) == len(op["qubits"])
+                        and all(type(q) is int and 0 <= q < n for q in op["qubits"]), "BASIS_SUPPORT")
+                require(len(op["qubits"]) == (1 if d["name"] == "rz" else 2), "GATE_ARITY")
+                require(len(d["parameters"]) == (1 if d["name"] == "rz" else 2), "GATE_PARAMETERS")
+                for p in d["parameters"]:
+                    finite_float(p)
+                h = matrix_hash(op["matrix"])
+                require(h == d["matrix_sha256"] and h in registry["local_gates"], "FORWARD_HASH_REGISTRY")
+                matrix_hash(op["inverse_matrix"])
+                require(len(op["inverse_matrix"]) == len(op["matrix"]), "INVERSE_SHAPE")
+                expected = registry["local_gates"][h]
+                require(expected["name"] == d["name"] and expected["parameters"] == d["parameters"], "REGISTRY_DESCRIPTOR")
+                record = dict(descriptor={"name": d["name"], "parameters": d["parameters"]},
+                              forward=op["matrix"], inverse=op["inverse_matrix"])

+                    require(gates[h] == record, "HASH_ALIAS_DIFFERENT_DESCRIPTOR_OR_INVERSE")
+                else:
+                    gates[h] = record
+                operations.append(dict(gate_hash=h, qubits=op["qubits"]))
+            canonical = C.canonical(dict(num_system_qubits=n, operations=[x["description"] for x in basis["operations"]],
+                                         hash_policy="ordered_local_basis_operations_v1"))
+            require(canonical == key, "ORDERED_BASIS_HASH")
+            if key in bases:
+                require(bases[key] == operations, "BASIS_ALIAS_MISMATCH")
+            else:
+                bases[key] = operations

+        if method == "PR":

+                require(type(comp["sign"]) is int and comp["sign"] in (-1, 1), "COMPONENT_SIGN")
+                require(type(support) is list and len(support) in (0, 1, 2) and len(set(support)) == len(support)

+                supports.append(dict(index=index, basis_hash=comp["basis"]["basis_hash"], support=support, sign=comp["sign"]))
+    require(set(gates) == set(registry["local_gates"]), "LOCAL_GATE_COVERAGE")

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""L one-shot runner; grant, launch and numerical worker are separate actions.
+
+No default execution. This implementation-stage SOURCE ships only an inactive
+contract, never an issued scientific grant or approval. Artificial tests call
+the small numerical kernel directly with manually supplied fixtures.
+"""
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("local_L_controller", ROOT / "src/trotterlib/h4_local_control.py")
+c = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(c)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
+    group.add_argument("--check-contract", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--issue-grant", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--launch", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--worker", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--witness", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--seal", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--namespace", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--command-json")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        if args.check_contract:
+            c.validate_contract(c.read(args.check_contract))
+            print(json.dumps(dict(status="VALID_INACTIVE_OR_ACTIVE_CONTRACT_NOT_EXECUTION", science_calls=0)))
+        elif args.issue_grant:
+            c.require(args.seal is not None and args.namespace is not None, "SEAL_AND_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED")
+            c.issue_grant(args.issue_grant, args.seal, args.namespace)
+        elif args.launch:
+            c.launch(args.launch)
+        elif args.worker:
+            c.worker(args.worker)
+        else:
+            command = json.loads(args.command_json)
+            c.require(type(command) is list and command and all(type(x) is str for x in command), "WITNESS_COMMAND")
+            return c.witness(args.witness, command)
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error:
+        print("L_STOP: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+
+Reuse frozen C fsync saves, hashes, locked nonrefundable budget and subreaper.
+No numerical backend import before worker authorization. No implicit grant.
+"""
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("L_reused_C_control", Path(__file__).with_name("h4_certificate_control.py"))
+C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)

+save, read, sha, digest, require, utc = C.save, C.read, C.sha, C.digest, C.require, C.utc
+LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
+ZERO = ("SCF", "FCI", "DF", "state_solve", "reference", "law_mean", "bias", "sampling", "RNG_replay", "compile", "N_G")
+
+
+def validate_contract(contract, *, active=False):
+    require(contract["kind"] == "H4_L_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT_V1", "L_CONTRACT_KIND")
+    require(contract["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_INPUT_DOMAIN")
+    require(contract["precision_bits"] == 128 and type(contract["precision_bits"]) is int, "L_FIXED_PRECISION")
+    require(contract["limits"] == LIMITS and all(type(x) is int for x in contract["limits"].values()), "L_FIXED_CALL_BUDGET")
+    require(contract["forbidden_calls"] == {k: 0 for k in ZERO}, "L_FORBIDDEN_BUDGET")
+    require(contract["expected_counts"] == dict(gates=148, bases=11, supports=324), "L_TARGET_COUNTS")
+    require(contract["automatic_retry"] is False and contract["mandatory_STOP"] is True, "L_RETRY_OR_STOP")
+    require(contract["formal_certificate_accepted"] is False and contract["N_G_authorized"] is False, "L_NO_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG")
+    require(contract["historical_compiler_target"] == "ORIGINAL_PROGRAM_UNCHANGED_MISSING_EVIDENCE", "L_K_TARGET_CHANGED")
+    if active:
+        require(all(contract[k] is True for k in ("execution_authorized", "grant_valid", "dispatch_enabled")), "L_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
+        require(contract.get("approval_file") and contract.get("approval_sha256"), "L_EXPLICIT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED")
+        require(sha(contract["approval_file"]) == contract["approval_sha256"], "L_APPROVAL_HASH")
+        approval = read(contract["approval_file"])
+        require(approval == dict(kind="L_EXPLICIT_NUMERICAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL", domain=contract["domain"],
+            technical_seal_sha256=contract["technical_seal_sha256"], namespace=contract["output_namespace"],
+            input_sha256=contract["input_sha256"], scope="DF_LOCAL_ONLY_FIXED128_NO_COMPILE_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG"), "L_APPROVAL_SCOPE")
+    return contract

+
+def verify_seal(seal):

+    require(seal["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_SEAL_DOMAIN")
+    for group in ("code_files", "runtime_files", "input_files"):
+        C.hashes(seal[group])
+    require(sha(sys.executable) == seal["python_executable_sha256"], "L_EXECUTABLE_HASH")
+    for path, expected in seal["code_git_files"].items():
+        raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", seal["SOURCE"] + ":" + path], cwd=ROOT)
+        import hashlib
+        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected, "L_SOURCE_COMMIT")

+
+def routing(contract, seal):
+    require(contract["domain"] == seal["domain"], "L_ARTIFICIAL_REAL_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
+    require(contract["technical_SOURCE"] == seal["SOURCE"], "L_SOURCE_BINDING")
+    require(contract["input_sha256"] == seal["input_files"], "L_INPUT_HASH_BINDING")
+    require(contract["model_path"] == seal["model_path"] and contract["registry_path"] == seal["registry_path"], "L_INPUT_PATH_BINDING")
+
+
+def issue_grant(contract_path, seal_path, namespace):
+    contract = validate_contract(read(contract_path), active=True)
+    seal = read(seal_path)
+    verify_seal(seal)
+    routing(contract, seal)
+    require(sha(seal_path) == contract["technical_seal_sha256"], "L_SEAL_BINDING")
+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()

+        approval_sha256=contract["approval_sha256"], one_shot=True)

+    save(ns / "contract.json", contract)
+    save(ns / "seal.json", seal)

+
+
+def authority(namespace, *, worker=False):
+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
+    contract = validate_contract(read(ns / "contract.json"), active=True)
+    grant, seal = read(ns / "grant.json"), read(ns / "seal.json")
+    kind = "L_SCIENCE_ONE_SHOT" if contract["domain"] == "SAVED_H4" else "L_ARTIFICIAL_ONE_SHOT"

+    routing(contract, seal)
+    if worker:
+        require(read(ns / "CONSUMED.json")["grant_id"] == grant["grant_id"] and (ns / "LAUNCH_CLAIM.json").is_file(), "L_WORKER_NOT_DISPATCHED")
+    else:
+        require(not (ns / "CONSUMED.json").exists(), "L_GRANT_ALREADY_USED")
+    return contract, seal
+
+
+def consume(namespace):
+    contract, seal = authority(namespace)
+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
+    save(ns / "CONSUMED.json", dict(grant_id=read(ns / "grant.json")["grant_id"], UTC=utc(), nonrefundable=True))
+    save(ns / "LAUNCH_CLAIM.json", dict(pid=os.getpid(), UTC=utc()))
+    return contract, seal
+
+
+def witness(directory, command):
+    # The C subreaper implementation is reused in an isolated witness process.
+    # Adapt only the scope label before durable creation of our NEW receipt.
+    original_save = C.save
+    def scoped_save(path, value, **kwargs):
+        if type(value) is dict and value.get("scope") == "NEW_C_WORKER_ONLY":
+            value = dict(value, scope="NEW_L_WORKER_ONLY")
+        return original_save(path, value, **kwargs)

+    try:

+
+def launch(namespace):

+        require(result["domain"] == contract["domain"] and result["precision_bits"] == 128

+        verify_seal(seal)
+        save(ns / "STOP.json", dict(status="L_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SAVED_COMBINATION_BLOCKED", mandatory_STOP=True,
+            native_exit=code, witness_reaped=True, formal_certificate_accepted=False,
+            execution_authorized=False, grant_valid=False, dispatch_enabled=False, N_G_authorized=False, UTC=utc()))
+    except BaseException as error:
+        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
+            process.terminate()

+            save(ns / "STOP.json", dict(status="FAILED_NO_RETRY", error=repr(error), mandatory_STOP=True, UTC=utc()))
+        raise
+
+
+def worker(namespace):
+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
+    contract, seal = authority(ns, worker=True)

+    try:

+"""L local-gate production kernel, using frozen C ball/rational helpers.
+
+No molecular/reference/law/bias/sampling/compiler APIs. Real input is passed
+only by the separately authorized L worker. Artificial tests supply tiny data.
+All ideal gates use exact binary64 real parameters, never decimal substitution.
+"""
+from fractions import Fraction as Q
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import struct
+
+
+def _load(name, filename):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, Path(__file__).with_name(filename))
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+C = _load("local_frozen_C_ball", "h4_ball_evidence.py")
+P = _load("local_frozen_rational", "h4_enclosure_prototype.py")
+require = C.require
+PRECISION = 128
+LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
+
+
+def finite_float(value):
+    require(type(value) in (str, float, int), "FINITE_BINARY64_PARAMETER")
+    value = float(value)
+    require(math.isfinite(value), "NONFINITE_PARAMETER")
+    return value
+
+
+def matrix_hash(raw):
+    require(type(raw) is list and len(raw) in (2, 4) and all(type(r) is list and len(r) == len(raw) for r in raw), "LOCAL_MATRIX_SHAPE")
+    packed = []
+    for row in raw:
+        for pair in row:
+            require(type(pair) is list and len(pair) == 2 and all(type(x) in (int, float) for x in pair), "COMPLEX_BINARY64_PAIR")
+            packed.append(struct.pack("<dd", *(finite_float(x) for x in pair)))
+    return hashlib.sha256(b"".join(packed)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def ideal_gate(descriptor, *, inverse=False):
+    """Qiskit1.3 RZ and XXPlusYY definitions, including beta's endian sign."""
+    require(type(inverse) is bool, "INVERSE_FLAG")
+    name, params = descriptor["name"], descriptor["parameters"]
+    require(name in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy") and len(params) == (1 if name == "rz" else 2), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
+    theta = C.real(finite_float(params[0])) * (-1 if inverse else 1)
+    if name == "rz":
+        return C.acb_mat([[C.phase(-theta / 2), 0], [0, C.phase(theta / 2)]])
+    beta = C.real(finite_float(params[1]))
+    cos, sin = (theta / 2).cos(), (theta / 2).sin()
+    return C.acb_mat([[1, 0, 0, 0], [0, cos, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(-beta), 0],
+                      [0, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(beta), cos, 0], [0, 0, 0, 1]])
+
+
+def discrepancy(descriptor, raw, *, inverse=False):
+    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
+    matrix_hash(raw)
+    ideal = ideal_gate(descriptor, inverse=inverse)
+    require(len(raw) == ideal.nrows(), "DESCRIPTOR_MATRIX_DIMENSION")
+    bound = C.frobenius(C.matrix(raw) - ideal)
+    require(bound.is_finite() and bound.lower() >= 0, "UNPROVED_LOCAL_BOUND")
+    return C.dyadic(bound.upper())
+
+
+def product_bound(errors):
+    """Frozen rational telescoping, outward rounded at each fixed128 step.
+
+    Avoid exponentially growing denominators in long product bounds. Exact
+    two-factor rational composition precedes each Arb outward rounding.
+    """
+    require(all(type(x) is Q and x >= 0 for x in errors), "NONNEGATIVE_EXACT_BOUND")
+    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
+    bound = Q(0)
+    for error in errors:
+        exact = P.product_error_bound([Q(1), Q(1)], [bound, error])
+        bound = C.dyadic(C.real(exact).upper())
+    return bound
+
+
+def conjugation_bound(forward, inverse):
+    # ||F D J - U D U*|| <= f+i+f*i for any unitary diagonal D.
+    return product_bound([inverse, forward])
+
+
+def signed_controlled_identity(sign, *, controlled=True):
+    """Artificial/formal branch oracle: a system sign becomes relative phase."""
+    require(type(sign) is int and sign in (-1, 1) and type(controlled) is bool, "SIGNED_CONTROL_DOMAIN")
+    return dict(zero_branch=1, one_branch=sign) if controlled else dict(system_global_phase=sign)
+
+
+def coverage_ledger(records):
+    """Preserve aggregate C total; refuse unproved overlaps or cancellation."""
+    require(type(records) is list and records, "COVERAGE_REQUIRED")
+    seen, owners = set(), {}
+    for record in records:
+        require(set(record) == {"id", "covers", "bound_ref"}, "COVERAGE_SCHEMA")
+        require(type(record["id"]) is str and record["id"] not in seen, "DUPLICATE_COVERAGE_RECORD")
+        seen.add(record["id"])
+        covers = record["covers"]
+        require(type(covers) is list and covers and all(type(x) is str for x in covers)
+                and len(set(covers)) == len(covers) and bool(record["bound_ref"]), "MISSING_COVERAGE_OR_BOUND")
+        for primitive in covers:
+            owners.setdefault(primitive, []).append(record["id"])
+    overlap = {k: v for k, v in owners.items() if len(v) > 1}
+    required = {"bias_distance", "basis_reuse", "phase_accumulation", "pi_rounding", "local_forward", "local_inverse"}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""L one-shot runner; grant, launch and numerical worker are separate actions.
+
+No default execution. This implementation-stage SOURCE ships only an inactive
+contract, never an issued scientific grant or approval. Artificial tests call
+the small numerical kernel directly with manually supplied fixtures.
+"""
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("local_L_controller", ROOT / "src/trotterlib/h4_local_control.py")
+c = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(c)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
+    group.add_argument("--check-contract", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--issue-grant", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--launch", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--worker", type=Path)
+    group.add_argument("--witness", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--seal", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--namespace", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--command-json")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        if args.check_contract:
+            c.validate_contract(c.read(args.check_contract))
+            print(json.dumps(dict(status="VALID_INACTIVE_OR_ACTIVE_CONTRACT_NOT_EXECUTION", science_calls=0)))
+        elif args.issue_grant:
+            c.require(args.seal is not None and args.namespace is not None, "SEAL_AND_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED")
+            c.issue_grant(args.issue_grant, args.seal, args.namespace)
+        elif args.launch:
+            c.launch(args.launch)
+        elif args.worker:
+            c.worker(args.worker)
+        else:
+            command = json.loads(args.command_json)
+            c.require(type(command) is list and command and all(type(x) is str for x in command), "WITNESS_COMMAND")
+            return c.witness(args.witness, command)
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error:
+        print("L_STOP: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""L-only authority, fixed budget and durable owned-process audit.
+
+Reuse frozen C fsync saves, hashes, locked nonrefundable budget and subreaper.
+No numerical backend import before worker authorization. No implicit grant.
+"""
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("L_reused_C_control", Path(__file__).with_name("h4_certificate_control.py"))
+C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+spec.loader.exec_module(C)
+save, read, sha, digest, require, utc = C.save, C.read, C.sha, C.digest, C.require, C.utc
+LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
+ZERO = ("SCF", "FCI", "DF", "state_solve", "reference", "law_mean", "bias", "sampling", "RNG_replay", "compile", "N_G")
+
+
+def validate_contract(contract, *, active=False):
+    require(contract["kind"] == "H4_L_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT_V1", "L_CONTRACT_KIND")
+    require(contract["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_INPUT_DOMAIN")
+    require(contract["precision_bits"] == 128 and type(contract["precision_bits"]) is int, "L_FIXED_PRECISION")
+    require(contract["limits"] == LIMITS and all(type(x) is int for x in contract["limits"].values()), "L_FIXED_CALL_BUDGET")
+    require(contract["forbidden_calls"] == {k: 0 for k in ZERO}, "L_FORBIDDEN_BUDGET")
+    require(contract["expected_counts"] == dict(gates=148, bases=11, supports=324), "L_TARGET_COUNTS")
+    require(contract["automatic_retry"] is False and contract["mandatory_STOP"] is True, "L_RETRY_OR_STOP")
+    require(contract["formal_certificate_accepted"] is False and contract["N_G_authorized"] is False, "L_NO_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG")
+    require(contract["historical_compiler_target"] == "ORIGINAL_PROGRAM_UNCHANGED_MISSING_EVIDENCE", "L_K_TARGET_CHANGED")
+    if active:
+        require(all(contract[k] is True for k in ("execution_authorized", "grant_valid", "dispatch_enabled")), "L_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
+        require(contract.get("approval_file") and contract.get("approval_sha256"), "L_EXPLICIT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED")
+        require(sha(contract["approval_file"]) == contract["approval_sha256"], "L_APPROVAL_HASH")
+        approval = read(contract["approval_file"])
+        require(approval == dict(kind="L_EXPLICIT_NUMERICAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL", domain=contract["domain"],
+            technical_seal_sha256=contract["technical_seal_sha256"], namespace=contract["output_namespace"],
+            input_sha256=contract["input_sha256"], scope="DF_LOCAL_ONLY_FIXED128_NO_COMPILE_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG"), "L_APPROVAL_SCOPE")
+    return contract
+
+
+def verify_seal(seal):
+    require(seal["kind"] == "H4_L_TECHNICAL_SOURCE_NOT_EXECUTION_GRANT", "L_SEAL_KIND")
+    require(seal["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_SEAL_DOMAIN")
+    for group in ("code_files", "runtime_files", "input_files"):
+        C.hashes(seal[group])
+    require(sha(sys.executable) == seal["python_executable_sha256"], "L_EXECUTABLE_HASH")
+    for path, expected in seal["code_git_files"].items():
+        raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", seal["SOURCE"] + ":" + path], cwd=ROOT)
+        import hashlib
+        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected, "L_SOURCE_COMMIT")
+
+
+def routing(contract, seal):
+    require(contract["domain"] == seal["domain"], "L_ARTIFICIAL_REAL_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
+    require(contract["technical_SOURCE"] == seal["SOURCE"], "L_SOURCE_BINDING")
+    require(contract["input_sha256"] == seal["input_files"], "L_INPUT_HASH_BINDING")
+    require(contract["model_path"] == seal["model_path"] and contract["registry_path"] == seal["registry_path"], "L_INPUT_PATH_BINDING")
+
+
+def issue_grant(contract_path, seal_path, namespace):
+    contract = validate_contract(read(contract_path), active=True)
+    seal = read(seal_path)
+    verify_seal(seal)
+    routing(contract, seal)
+    require(sha(seal_path) == contract["technical_seal_sha256"], "L_SEAL_BINDING")
+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
+    require(str(ns) == contract["output_namespace"] and not ns.exists(), "L_FRESH_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED")
+    ns.mkdir(parents=True)
+    grant = dict(kind="L_SCIENCE_ONE_SHOT" if contract["domain"] == "SAVED_H4" else "L_ARTIFICIAL_ONE_SHOT",
+        namespace=str(ns), contract_sha256=sha(contract_path), seal_sha256=sha(seal_path),
+        approval_sha256=contract["approval_sha256"], one_shot=True)
+    grant["grant_id"] = digest(grant)
+    save(ns / "contract.json", contract)
+    save(ns / "seal.json", seal)
+    save(ns / "grant.json", grant)
+    return grant
+
+
+def authority(namespace, *, worker=False):
+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
+    contract = validate_contract(read(ns / "contract.json"), active=True)
+    grant, seal = read(ns / "grant.json"), read(ns / "seal.json")
+    kind = "L_SCIENCE_ONE_SHOT" if contract["domain"] == "SAVED_H4" else "L_ARTIFICIAL_ONE_SHOT"
+    require(grant["kind"] == kind and grant["namespace"] == contract["output_namespace"] == str(ns), "L_GRANT_NAMESPACE_OR_KIND")
+    require(grant["grant_id"] == digest({k: v for k, v in grant.items() if k != "grant_id"}), "L_GRANT_DIGEST")
+    require(sha(ns / "contract.json") == grant["contract_sha256"] and sha(ns / "seal.json") == grant["seal_sha256"] == contract["technical_seal_sha256"], "L_GRANT_BINDING")
+    require(grant["approval_sha256"] == contract["approval_sha256"], "L_APPROVAL_BINDING")
+    require(not (ns / "STOP.json").exists(), "L_ALREADY_STOPPED")
+    verify_seal(seal)
+    routing(contract, seal)
+    if worker:
+        require(read(ns / "CONSUMED.json")["grant_id"] == grant["grant_id"] and (ns / "LAUNCH_CLAIM.json").is_file(), "L_WORKER_NOT_DISPATCHED")
+    else:
+        require(not (ns / "CONSUMED.json").exists(), "L_GRANT_ALREADY_USED")
+    return contract, seal
+
+
+def consume(namespace):

+    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()

+"""L local-gate production kernel, using frozen C ball/rational helpers.
+
+No molecular/reference/law/bias/sampling/compiler APIs. Real input is passed
+only by the separately authorized L worker. Artificial tests supply tiny data.
+All ideal gates use exact binary64 real parameters, never decimal substitution.
+"""
+from fractions import Fraction as Q
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import struct
+
+
+def _load(name, filename):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, Path(__file__).with_name(filename))
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+C = _load("local_frozen_C_ball", "h4_ball_evidence.py")
+P = _load("local_frozen_rational", "h4_enclosure_prototype.py")
+require = C.require
+PRECISION = 128
+LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
+
+
+def finite_float(value):
+    require(type(value) in (str, float, int), "FINITE_BINARY64_PARAMETER")
+    value = float(value)
+    require(math.isfinite(value), "NONFINITE_PARAMETER")
+    return value
+
+
+def matrix_hash(raw):
+    require(type(raw) is list and len(raw) in (2, 4) and all(type(r) is list and len(r) == len(raw) for r in raw), "LOCAL_MATRIX_SHAPE")
+    packed = []
+    for row in raw:
+        for pair in row:
+            require(type(pair) is list and len(pair) == 2 and all(type(x) in (int, float) for x in pair), "COMPLEX_BINARY64_PAIR")
+            packed.append(struct.pack("<dd", *(finite_float(x) for x in pair)))
+    return hashlib.sha256(b"".join(packed)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def ideal_gate(descriptor, *, inverse=False):
+    """Qiskit1.3 RZ and XXPlusYY definitions, including beta's endian sign."""
+    require(type(inverse) is bool, "INVERSE_FLAG")
+    name, params = descriptor["name"], descriptor["parameters"]
+    require(name in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy") and len(params) == (1 if name == "rz" else 2), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
+    theta = C.real(finite_float(params[0])) * (-1 if inverse else 1)
+    if name == "rz":
+        return C.acb_mat([[C.phase(-theta / 2), 0], [0, C.phase(theta / 2)]])
+    beta = C.real(finite_float(params[1]))
+    cos, sin = (theta / 2).cos(), (theta / 2).sin()
+    return C.acb_mat([[1, 0, 0, 0], [0, cos, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(-beta), 0],
+                      [0, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(beta), cos, 0], [0, 0, 0, 1]])
+
+
+def discrepancy(descriptor, raw, *, inverse=False):
+    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
+    matrix_hash(raw)
+    ideal = ideal_gate(descriptor, inverse=inverse)
+    require(len(raw) == ideal.nrows(), "DESCRIPTOR_MATRIX_DIMENSION")
+    bound = C.frobenius(C.matrix(raw) - ideal)
+    require(bound.is_finite() and bound.lower() >= 0, "UNPROVED_LOCAL_BOUND")
+    return C.dyadic(bound.upper())
+
+
+def product_bound(errors):
+    """Frozen rational telescoping, outward rounded at each fixed128 step.
+
+    Avoid exponentially growing denominators in long product bounds. Exact
+    two-factor rational composition precedes each Arb outward rounding.
+    """
+    require(all(type(x) is Q and x >= 0 for x in errors), "NONNEGATIVE_EXACT_BOUND")
+    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
+    bound = Q(0)
+    for error in errors:
+        exact = P.product_error_bound([Q(1), Q(1)], [bound, error])
+        bound = C.dyadic(C.real(exact).upper())
+    return bound
+
+
+def conjugation_bound(forward, inverse):
+    # ||F D J - U D U*|| <= f+i+f*i for any unitary diagonal D.
+    return product_bound([inverse, forward])
+
+
+def signed_controlled_identity(sign, *, controlled=True):
+    """Artificial/formal branch oracle: a system sign becomes relative phase."""
+    require(type(sign) is int and sign in (-1, 1) and type(controlled) is bool, "SIGNED_CONTROL_DOMAIN")
+    return dict(zero_branch=1, one_branch=sign) if controlled else dict(system_global_phase=sign)
+
+
+def coverage_ledger(records):
+    """Preserve aggregate C total; refuse unproved overlaps or cancellation."""
+    require(type(records) is list and records, "COVERAGE_REQUIRED")
+    seen, owners = set(), {}
+    for record in records:
+        require(set(record) == {"id", "covers", "bound_ref"}, "COVERAGE_SCHEMA")
+        require(type(record["id"]) is str and record["id"] not in seen, "DUPLICATE_COVERAGE_RECORD")
+        seen.add(record["id"])
+        covers = record["covers"]
+        require(type(covers) is list and covers and all(type(x) is str for x in covers)
+                and len(set(covers)) == len(covers) and bool(record["bound_ref"]), "MISSING_COVERAGE_OR_BOUND")
+        for primitive in covers:
+            owners.setdefault(primitive, []).append(record["id"])
+    overlap = {k: v for k, v in owners.items() if len(v) > 1}
+    required = {"bias_distance", "basis_reuse", "phase_accumulation", "pi_rounding", "local_forward", "local_inverse"}
+    missing = sorted(required - set(owners))
+    return dict(records=records, overlapping_primitives=overlap, uncovered_primitives=missing,
+                status="COMBINATION_BLOCKED" if overlap or missing else "DISJOINT_COVERAGE_ONLY_NO_ACCEPTANCE",
+                simple_addition_permitted=not overlap and not missing,
+                aggregate_C_total_modified=False, numerical_combination_performed=False,
+                formal_certificate_accepted=False)
+
+
+def plan_from_saved(model, registry, *, artificial=False):
+    """Static descriptor/byte membership checks; no ball operations here."""
+    require(model["representation"] == "df_native" and model["qubit_order"] == "qiskit_little_endian", "DF_MODEL_SCOPE")
+    n = model["n_qubits"]
+    require(type(n) is int and n > 0, "MODEL_QUBITS")
+    gates, bases, supports = {}, {}, []
+    case_bases, block_counts = {}, {}
+    for method in ("PF", "PR"):
+        case = model["cases"][method]
+        case_bases[method] = set()
+        block_counts[method] = len(case["blocks"])
+        for item in case["blocks"] + case["components"]:
+            basis = item["basis"]
+            key = basis["basis_hash"]
+            operations = []
+            for op in basis["operations"]:
+                d = op["description"]
+                require(d["name"] in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy"), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
+                require(d["qubits"] == op["qubits"] and len(set(op["qubits"])) == len(op["qubits"])
+                        and all(type(q) is int and 0 <= q < n for q in op["qubits"]), "BASIS_SUPPORT")
+                require(len(op["qubits"]) == (1 if d["name"] == "rz" else 2), "GATE_ARITY")
+                require(len(d["parameters"]) == (1 if d["name"] == "rz" else 2), "GATE_PARAMETERS")
+                for p in d["parameters"]:
+                    finite_float(p)
+                h = matrix_hash(op["matrix"])
+                require(h == d["matrix_sha256"] and h in registry["local_gates"], "FORWARD_HASH_REGISTRY")
+                matrix_hash(op["inverse_matrix"])
+                require(len(op["inverse_matrix"]) == len(op["matrix"]), "INVERSE_SHAPE")
+                expected = registry["local_gates"][h]
+                require(expected["name"] == d["name"] and expected["parameters"] == d["parameters"], "REGISTRY_DESCRIPTOR")
+                record = dict(descriptor={"name": d["name"], "parameters": d["parameters"]},
+                              forward=op["matrix"], inverse=op["inverse_matrix"])
+                if h in gates:
+                    require(gates[h] == record, "HASH_ALIAS_DIFFERENT_DESCRIPTOR_OR_INVERSE")
+                else:
+                    gates[h] = record
+                operations.append(dict(gate_hash=h, qubits=op["qubits"]))
+            canonical = C.canonical(dict(num_system_qubits=n, operations=[x["description"] for x in basis["operations"]],
+                                         hash_policy="ordered_local_basis_operations_v1"))
+            require(canonical == key, "ORDERED_BASIS_HASH")
+            if key in bases:
+                require(bases[key] == operations, "BASIS_ALIAS_MISMATCH")
+            else:
+                bases[key] = operations
+            case_bases[method].add(key)
+        if method == "PR":
+            for index, comp in enumerate(case["components"]):
+                support = comp["support"]
+                require(type(comp["sign"]) is int and comp["sign"] in (-1, 1), "COMPONENT_SIGN")
+                require(type(support) is list and len(support) in (0, 1, 2) and len(set(support)) == len(support)
+                        and all(type(q) is int and 0 <= q < n for q in support), "SYMBOLIC_COMPONENT_SUPPORT")
+                supports.append(dict(index=index, basis_hash=comp["basis"]["basis_hash"], support=support, sign=comp["sign"]))
+    require(set(gates) == set(registry["local_gates"]), "LOCAL_GATE_COVERAGE")
+    if not artificial:
+        require((n, len(gates), len(bases), len(supports)) == (8, 148, 11, 324), "FIXED_H4_SCOPE_COUNTS")
+    return dict(domain="ARTIFICIAL" if artificial else "SAVED_H4", n=n, gates=gates, bases=bases,
+                supports=supports, case_bases={k: sorted(v) for k, v in case_bases.items()}, block_counts=block_counts)
+
+
+def diagnose(plan, budget, *, emit, authorize_before_call):
+    """Exact fixed128 local/basis/support work; reservation is never refunded."""
+    gate_results, basis_results = {}, {}
+    with C.ctx.workprec(PRECISION):
+        for h, gate in sorted(plan["gates"].items()):
+            values = {}
+            for direction in ("forward", "inverse"):
+                authorize_before_call()
+                budget.take(direction)
+                values[direction] = discrepancy(gate["descriptor"], gate[direction], inverse=direction == "inverse")
+                emit("local_" + h + "_" + direction + ".json",
+                     dict(kind="LOCAL_GATE_DISCREPANCY", matrix_hash=h, direction=direction,
+                          discrepancy_upper_exact=str(values[direction]), precision_bits=PRECISION,
+                          ideal_semantics="Qiskit1.3 exact real gate on encoded binary64 parameters",
+                          literal_decomposition_or_compiler_proved=False))
+            gate_results[h] = values
+        for key, operations in sorted(plan["bases"].items()):
+            authorize_before_call()
+            budget.take("basis")
+            forward = product_bound([gate_results[x["gate_hash"]]["forward"] for x in operations])
+            inverse = product_bound([gate_results[x["gate_hash"]]["inverse"] for x in reversed(operations)])
+            pair = conjugation_bound(forward, inverse)
+            basis_results[key] = pair
+            emit("basis_" + key + ".json", dict(kind="ORDERED_BASIS_AND_CONTROL_BOUND", basis_hash=key,
+                 forward_upper_exact=str(forward), inverse_upper_exact=str(inverse),
+                 control_zero_upper_exact=str(pair), control_one_upper_exact=str(pair),
+                 forward_gate_order=[x["gate_hash"] for x in operations],
+                 inverse_gate_order=[x["gate_hash"] for x in reversed(operations)],
+                 proof="Ideal factors unitary; telescoping spectral bound; same bound for F*D*J with D=I or unitary signed diagonal.",
+                 scope="Rounded basis versus ideal gate symbols; diagonal/control synthesis and compiler not certified"))
+        for comp in plan["supports"]:

+                 ideal_diagonal_involution=True, DF_fragment_lambda_A_squared_is_involution=False))

# H4 K静的保証調査・L production実装

2026-10-23。専用branch `codex/non-df-h4-kl-production-20261023`、基点 `669a6ee576a032e8bf54d7ff47d570cc70d7eca5`、直近adapter SOURCE `14c0f8b0adda6160d507807334b82da0531a0e35`。**新技術SOURCEは `eb195bf2dedd0aed9d80ad7f84948b59ea53d854`**。C科学SOURCE `e80d7510880f8db993b777c627bb8e95b05a070d`、元科学SOURCE `0c329b30a81accb35c212be8defa66fee0dd0f12`、T SOURCE・結果・旧grant/STOPを変更していない。

**Kは限定的なexact identityとcompiler全体の証明を分離し、旧programの保証をMISSING_EVIDENCEのまま維持した。Lは既存Cの数値・監査helperを流用して、128 bit固定の局所gate診断とone-shot runnerを実装・封印した。実H4のL数値実行は0、科学grant発行0。** 新compiled系列、正式受理A、N/G、詳細科学レビュー、最終evidence freezeは開始していない。

## 固定資料・運用・流用

GitHubで基点branchが669a6ee57を指すこと、基点commit/tree、14c0f8b0a commit/tree、必須23 fileのbytesを実確認した。大きい旧gate_bindings.jsonはcontents APIのcontentが空のため、固定blobを取得して全bytesを照合した。[GitHub記録](../artifacts/non_df_h4_kl_production/2026-10-23/github_verification.json)。新SOURCEの公開状態は別に扱う。

最新版共通運用指示は、ユーザーが追加した `/home/AbeHiromu/projects/partially-randomized-trotter-worktrees/research_project_instructions_unified_2026-10-23.md` の§8.4・§10を読み適用した。[受領SHA](../artifacts/non_df_h4_kl_production/2026-10-23/instruction_receipt.json)。当初の所在未確認を解消し、旧版を運用正本として併用していない。

[流用・適合性記録](../artifacts/non_df_h4_kl_production/2026-10-23/reuse_audit.json)：

| 既存資産 | 流用した機能 | 今回の差分 |
|---|---|---|
| h4_ball_evidence.py / C SOURCE | exact binary64 import、Acb matrix/phase、Frobenius上界、dyadic endpoint | full-H・reference・law・bias関数を呼ばず、2×2/4×4だけを使用 |
| h4_enclosure_prototype.py | exact rational product_error_bound、tiny exponential oracle | 2因子のexact合成後、各段で128 bitの外向き丸め。長い分母増大を抑制 |
| h4_certificate_control.py | fsync/exclusive save、SHA、locked非返却CallBudget、owned subreaper witness | L専用authority・予算・固定128を追加。隔離witness内で新receiptのscopeラベルだけをLへ適合 |
| 前回verify_h4_evidence_binding.py | 既知4case・固定runtimeのbounded compiler調査 | passごとの適用条件・位相・精度・未証明事項を追加 |
| 既存T67＋binding33 test | schema、phase/control/basis、scope/SHA、二重計上等 | 原本を変更せず、新L48 testを追加 |

既存C runnerはfull-HとC固有の精度schedule・grant/予算を扱うため、そのままLとして実行できない。新kernel/controllerはこの差分だけを別SOURCEとして追加した。別研究の結果・grant・科学承認を流用したものではない。

固定科学対象は従来どおりlinear H4/隣接1.00 Å/STO-3G、8 system qubit、Nα=Nβ=2、Pauli184項/PR prefix27、DF tol-only1e-8/rank10/PR prefix1＋one-body、S2/T=.8/q8/r4/K4、4方式×5精度×両軸。H2のS2/Yoshida4系列と混合していない。

## K：SOURCE-level保証の成立範囲

[拡張調査JSON](../artifacts/non_df_h4_kl_production/2026-10-23/K01/K_report.json)、[pass対応CSV](../artifacts/non_df_h4_kl_production/2026-10-23/K01/K_pass_map.csv)。前回調査を流用し、固定Qiskit1.3.0、rz/sx/x/cx、optimization1、seed17、元wrapper/compilerを維持した。候補SOURCE経路と、旧programで実際に実行されたpass列を分離する。後者はreceipt不在のためUNKNOWN。

| 変換 | SOURCEで確認した条件・数学的意味 | 残る保証 |
|---|---|---|
| InverseCancellation | 設定されたself-inverse/inverse pairに対する隣接消去。exact A†A=I、Pauli/H等の恒等式はTで確認済み | Pythonからaccelerated matcher/DAG処理を呼ぶ。全SX/T/CX等のpair、実matching・mutation、旧pass instanceをTだけで証明していない |
| Optimize1qGatesDecomposition | 1Q runを集約しEuler gate列を選択。global phaseを新DAGへ保持するSOURCEがある | binary64のrun matrix、accelerated Euler分解・角度選択・丸めの一様保証がない |
| Controlled decomposition | definitionをunrollしglobal phaseを集める。control後はrelative phaseとして保持が必要 | 実分解・pi/angle/phase蓄積の数値誤差、全control-state/ancilla条件が未証明 |
| BasisTranslator/equivalence library | basis集合を探索しequivalenceに従ってDAGを書き換える | 全rule・parameter/global phase・accelerated変換・旧探索結果の網羅がない |
| HighLevelSynthesis | high-level operation/target/plugin等に応じたlowering | plugin選択・前提・分岐・数値処理・旧traceが未取得 |
| UnitarySynthesis | translatorが候補経路を含む。exact/approximationを区別する必要 | 実際の呼出有無、approximation_degree/数値kernelの保証がない |
| DF basis/control/wrapper | 逆順inverse、diag(I,U)、H-CU-H / H-CU-Sdg-Hのexact定義 | 丸めlocal行列→理想gateはLの対象。それでもliteral分解→postcompiledのK保証は残る |

"""L local-gate production kernel, using frozen C ball/rational helpers.

No molecular/reference/law/bias/sampling/compiler APIs. Real input is passed
only by the separately authorized L worker. Artificial tests supply tiny data.
All ideal gates use exact binary64 real parameters, never decimal substitution.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import math
from pathlib import Path
import struct


def _load(name, filename):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, Path(__file__).with_name(filename))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


C = _load("local_frozen_C_ball", "h4_ball_evidence.py")
P = _load("local_frozen_rational", "h4_enclosure_prototype.py")
require = C.require
PRECISION = 128
LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)


def finite_float(value):
    require(type(value) in (str, float, int), "FINITE_BINARY64_PARAMETER")
    value = float(value)
    require(math.isfinite(value), "NONFINITE_PARAMETER")
    return value


def matrix_hash(raw):
    require(type(raw) is list and len(raw) in (2, 4) and all(type(r) is list and len(r) == len(raw) for r in raw), "LOCAL_MATRIX_SHAPE")
    packed = []
    for row in raw:
        for pair in row:
            require(type(pair) is list and len(pair) == 2 and all(type(x) in (int, float) for x in pair), "COMPLEX_BINARY64_PAIR")
            packed.append(struct.pack("<dd", *(finite_float(x) for x in pair)))
    return hashlib.sha256(b"".join(packed)).hexdigest()


def ideal_gate(descriptor, *, inverse=False):
    """Qiskit1.3 RZ and XXPlusYY definitions, including beta's endian sign."""
    require(type(inverse) is bool, "INVERSE_FLAG")
    name, params = descriptor["name"], descriptor["parameters"]
    require(name in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy") and len(params) == (1 if name == "rz" else 2), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
    theta = C.real(finite_float(params[0])) * (-1 if inverse else 1)
    if name == "rz":
        return C.acb_mat([[C.phase(-theta / 2), 0], [0, C.phase(theta / 2)]])
    beta = C.real(finite_float(params[1]))
    cos, sin = (theta / 2).cos(), (theta / 2).sin()
    return C.acb_mat([[1, 0, 0, 0], [0, cos, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(-beta), 0],
                      [0, C.acb(0, -sin) * C.phase(beta), cos, 0], [0, 0, 0, 1]])


def discrepancy(descriptor, raw, *, inverse=False):
    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
    matrix_hash(raw)
    ideal = ideal_gate(descriptor, inverse=inverse)
    require(len(raw) == ideal.nrows(), "DESCRIPTOR_MATRIX_DIMENSION")
    bound = C.frobenius(C.matrix(raw) - ideal)
    require(bound.is_finite() and bound.lower() >= 0, "UNPROVED_LOCAL_BOUND")
    return C.dyadic(bound.upper())


def product_bound(errors):
    """Frozen rational telescoping, outward rounded at each fixed128 step.

    Avoid exponentially growing denominators in long product bounds. Exact
    two-factor rational composition precedes each Arb outward rounding.
    """
    require(all(type(x) is Q and x >= 0 for x in errors), "NONNEGATIVE_EXACT_BOUND")
    require(C.ctx.prec == PRECISION, "FIXED_128_BIT_CONTEXT")
    bound = Q(0)
    for error in errors:
        exact = P.product_error_bound([Q(1), Q(1)], [bound, error])
        bound = C.dyadic(C.real(exact).upper())
    return bound


def conjugation_bound(forward, inverse):
    # ||F D J - U D U*|| <= f+i+f*i for any unitary diagonal D.
    return product_bound([inverse, forward])


def signed_controlled_identity(sign, *, controlled=True):
    """Artificial/formal branch oracle: a system sign becomes relative phase."""
    require(type(sign) is int and sign in (-1, 1) and type(controlled) is bool, "SIGNED_CONTROL_DOMAIN")
    return dict(zero_branch=1, one_branch=sign) if controlled else dict(system_global_phase=sign)


def coverage_ledger(records):
    """Preserve aggregate C total; refuse unproved overlaps or cancellation."""
    require(type(records) is list and records, "COVERAGE_REQUIRED")
    seen, owners = set(), {}
    for record in records:
        require(set(record) == {"id", "covers", "bound_ref"}, "COVERAGE_SCHEMA")
        require(type(record["id"]) is str and record["id"] not in seen, "DUPLICATE_COVERAGE_RECORD")
        seen.add(record["id"])
        covers = record["covers"]
        require(type(covers) is list and covers and all(type(x) is str for x in covers)
                and len(set(covers)) == len(covers) and bool(record["bound_ref"]), "MISSING_COVERAGE_OR_BOUND")
        for primitive in covers:
            owners.setdefault(primitive, []).append(record["id"])
    overlap = {k: v for k, v in owners.items() if len(v) > 1}
    required = {"bias_distance", "basis_reuse", "phase_accumulation", "pi_rounding", "local_forward", "local_inverse"}
    missing = sorted(required - set(owners))
    return dict(records=records, overlapping_primitives=overlap, uncovered_primitives=missing,
                status="COMBINATION_BLOCKED" if overlap or missing else "DISJOINT_COVERAGE_ONLY_NO_ACCEPTANCE",
                simple_addition_permitted=not overlap and not missing,
                aggregate_C_total_modified=False, numerical_combination_performed=False,
                formal_certificate_accepted=False)


def plan_from_saved(model, registry, *, artificial=False):
    """Static descriptor/byte membership checks; no ball operations here."""
    require(model["representation"] == "df_native" and model["qubit_order"] == "qiskit_little_endian", "DF_MODEL_SCOPE")
    n = model["n_qubits"]
    require(type(n) is int and n > 0, "MODEL_QUBITS")
    gates, bases, supports = {}, {}, []
    case_bases, block_counts = {}, {}
    for method in ("PF", "PR"):
        case = model["cases"][method]
        case_bases[method] = set()
        block_counts[method] = len(case["blocks"])
        for item in case["blocks"] + case["components"]:
            basis = item["basis"]
            key = basis["basis_hash"]
            operations = []
            for op in basis["operations"]:
                d = op["description"]
                require(d["name"] in ("rz", "xx_plus_yy"), "UNSUPPORTED_LOCAL_GATE")
                require(d["qubits"] == op["qubits"] and len(set(op["qubits"])) == len(op["qubits"])
                        and all(type(q) is int and 0 <= q < n for q in op["qubits"]), "BASIS_SUPPORT")
                require(len(op["qubits"]) == (1 if d["name"] == "rz" else 2), "GATE_ARITY")
                require(len(d["parameters"]) == (1 if d["name"] == "rz" else 2), "GATE_PARAMETERS")
                for p in d["parameters"]:
                    finite_float(p)
                h = matrix_hash(op["matrix"])
                require(h == d["matrix_sha256"] and h in registry["local_gates"], "FORWARD_HASH_REGISTRY")
                matrix_hash(op["inverse_matrix"])
                require(len(op["inverse_matrix"]) == len(op["matrix"]), "INVERSE_SHAPE")
                expected = registry["local_gates"][h]
                require(expected["name"] == d["name"] and expected["parameters"] == d["parameters"], "REGISTRY_DESCRIPTOR")
                record = dict(descriptor={"name": d["name"], "parameters": d["parameters"]},
                              forward=op["matrix"], inverse=op["inverse_matrix"])
                if h in gates:
                    require(gates[h] == record, "HASH_ALIAS_DIFFERENT_DESCRIPTOR_OR_INVERSE")
                else:
                    gates[h] = record
                operations.append(dict(gate_hash=h, qubits=op["qubits"]))
            canonical = C.canonical(dict(num_system_qubits=n, operations=[x["description"] for x in basis["operations"]],
                                         hash_policy="ordered_local_basis_operations_v1"))
            require(canonical == key, "ORDERED_BASIS_HASH")
            if key in bases:
                require(bases[key] == operations, "BASIS_ALIAS_MISMATCH")
            else:
                bases[key] = operations
            case_bases[method].add(key)
        if method == "PR":
            for index, comp in enumerate(case["components"]):
                support = comp["support"]
                require(type(comp["sign"]) is int and comp["sign"] in (-1, 1), "COMPONENT_SIGN")
                require(type(support) is list and len(support) in (0, 1, 2) and len(set(support)) == len(support)
                        and all(type(q) is int and 0 <= q < n for q in support), "SYMBOLIC_COMPONENT_SUPPORT")
                supports.append(dict(index=index, basis_hash=comp["basis"]["basis_hash"], support=support, sign=comp["sign"]))
    require(set(gates) == set(registry["local_gates"]), "LOCAL_GATE_COVERAGE")
    if not artificial:
        require((n, len(gates), len(bases), len(supports)) == (8, 148, 11, 324), "FIXED_H4_SCOPE_COUNTS")
    return dict(domain="ARTIFICIAL" if artificial else "SAVED_H4", n=n, gates=gates, bases=bases,
                supports=supports, case_bases={k: sorted(v) for k, v in case_bases.items()}, block_counts=block_counts)


def diagnose(plan, budget, *, emit, authorize_before_call):
    """Exact fixed128 local/basis/support work; reservation is never refunded."""
    gate_results, basis_results = {}, {}
    with C.ctx.workprec(PRECISION):
        for h, gate in sorted(plan["gates"].items()):
            values = {}
            for direction in ("forward", "inverse"):
                authorize_before_call()
                budget.take(direction)
                values[direction] = discrepancy(gate["descriptor"], gate[direction], inverse=direction == "inverse")
                emit("local_" + h + "_" + direction + ".json",
                     dict(kind="LOCAL_GATE_DISCREPANCY", matrix_hash=h, direction=direction,
                          discrepancy_upper_exact=str(values[direction]), precision_bits=PRECISION,
                          ideal_semantics="Qiskit1.3 exact real gate on encoded binary64 parameters",
                          literal_decomposition_or_compiler_proved=False))
            gate_results[h] = values
        for key, operations in sorted(plan["bases"].items()):
            authorize_before_call()
            budget.take("basis")
            forward = product_bound([gate_results[x["gate_hash"]]["forward"] for x in operations])
            inverse = product_bound([gate_results[x["gate_hash"]]["inverse"] for x in reversed(operations)])
            pair = conjugation_bound(forward, inverse)
            basis_results[key] = pair
            emit("basis_" + key + ".json", dict(kind="ORDERED_BASIS_AND_CONTROL_BOUND", basis_hash=key,
                 forward_upper_exact=str(forward), inverse_upper_exact=str(inverse),
                 control_zero_upper_exact=str(pair), control_one_upper_exact=str(pair),
                 forward_gate_order=[x["gate_hash"] for x in operations],
                 inverse_gate_order=[x["gate_hash"] for x in reversed(operations)],
                 proof="Ideal factors unitary; telescoping spectral bound; same bound for F*D*J with D=I or unitary signed diagonal.",
                 scope="Rounded basis versus ideal gate symbols; diagonal/control synthesis and compiler not certified"))
        for comp in plan["supports"]:
            authorize_before_call()
            budget.take("support")
            require(comp["basis_hash"] in basis_results, "UNCOVERED_COMPONENT_BASIS")
            signed_controlled_identity(comp["sign"])
            emit("support_" + str(comp["index"]) + ".json", dict(kind="SYMBOLIC_SIGNED_Z_SUPPORT_COVERAGE", **comp,
                 ideal_diagonal_involution=True, DF_fragment_lambda_A_squared_is_involution=False))
        uniform = {}
        for method in ("PF", "PR"):
            count = 8 * (2 * plan["block_counts"][method] + (4 * 5 if method == "PR" else 0))
            maximum = max((basis_results[h] for h in plan["case_bases"][method]), default=Q(0))
            error = product_bound([maximum] * count)
            uniform[method] = dict(maximum_conjugations=count, local_basis_transfer_upper_exact=str(error),
                                   event_orders=[0, 2, 4] if method == "PR" else [], axes_reused=["cosine", "sine"],
                                   precisions_reused=["0.05", "0.01", "0.005", "0.001", "0.0005"],
                                   phase_scope="Fixed same real angles/signs; global and relative phases retained, not synthesized numerically here",
                                   bound_excludes="New diagonal parameter rounding, literal gate decomposition, compiler transforms, physical preparation and shot accounting")
            uniform[method]["measurement_scale_B_not_applied"] = True
    ledger = coverage_ledger([
        dict(id="saved_C_total", covers=["bias_distance", "basis_reuse", "phase_accumulation", "pi_rounding"], bound_ref="Existing C axes[].total_error_upper"),
        dict(id="new_L_uniform_basis", covers=["local_forward", "local_inverse", "basis_reuse"], bound_ref="L uniform basis bound")])
    return dict(status="LOCAL_ENCLOSURES_COMPLETE_COMBINATION_BLOCKED", domain=plan["domain"],
                precision_bits=PRECISION, uniform_basis_bounds=uniform, coverage_ledger=ledger,
                formal_certificate_accepted=False, N_G_authorized=False, automatic_retry=False,
                mandatory_STOP=True, compiler_transfer="MISSING_EVIDENCE")

"""L-only authority, fixed budget and durable owned-process audit.

Reuse frozen C fsync saves, hashes, locked nonrefundable budget and subreaper.
No numerical backend import before worker authorization. No implicit grant.
"""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("L_reused_C_control", Path(__file__).with_name("h4_certificate_control.py"))
C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(C)
save, read, sha, digest, require, utc = C.save, C.read, C.sha, C.digest, C.require, C.utc
LIMITS = dict(forward=148, inverse=148, basis=11, support=324)
ZERO = ("SCF", "FCI", "DF", "state_solve", "reference", "law_mean", "bias", "sampling", "RNG_replay", "compile", "N_G")


def validate_contract(contract, *, active=False):
    require(contract["kind"] == "H4_L_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT_V1", "L_CONTRACT_KIND")
    require(contract["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_INPUT_DOMAIN")
    require(contract["precision_bits"] == 128 and type(contract["precision_bits"]) is int, "L_FIXED_PRECISION")
    require(contract["limits"] == LIMITS and all(type(x) is int for x in contract["limits"].values()), "L_FIXED_CALL_BUDGET")
    require(contract["forbidden_calls"] == {k: 0 for k in ZERO}, "L_FORBIDDEN_BUDGET")
    require(contract["expected_counts"] == dict(gates=148, bases=11, supports=324), "L_TARGET_COUNTS")
    require(contract["automatic_retry"] is False and contract["mandatory_STOP"] is True, "L_RETRY_OR_STOP")
    require(contract["formal_certificate_accepted"] is False and contract["N_G_authorized"] is False, "L_NO_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG")
    require(contract["historical_compiler_target"] == "ORIGINAL_PROGRAM_UNCHANGED_MISSING_EVIDENCE", "L_K_TARGET_CHANGED")
    if active:
        require(all(contract[k] is True for k in ("execution_authorized", "grant_valid", "dispatch_enabled")), "L_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED")
        require(contract.get("approval_file") and contract.get("approval_sha256"), "L_EXPLICIT_APPROVAL_REQUIRED")
        require(sha(contract["approval_file"]) == contract["approval_sha256"], "L_APPROVAL_HASH")
        approval = read(contract["approval_file"])
        require(approval == dict(kind="L_EXPLICIT_NUMERICAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL", domain=contract["domain"],
            technical_seal_sha256=contract["technical_seal_sha256"], namespace=contract["output_namespace"],
            input_sha256=contract["input_sha256"], scope="DF_LOCAL_ONLY_FIXED128_NO_COMPILE_ACCEPTANCE_OR_NG"), "L_APPROVAL_SCOPE")
    return contract


def verify_seal(seal):
    require(seal["kind"] == "H4_L_TECHNICAL_SOURCE_NOT_EXECUTION_GRANT", "L_SEAL_KIND")
    require(seal["domain"] in ("SAVED_H4", "ARTIFICIAL"), "L_SEAL_DOMAIN")
    for group in ("code_files", "runtime_files", "input_files"):
        C.hashes(seal[group])
    require(sha(sys.executable) == seal["python_executable_sha256"], "L_EXECUTABLE_HASH")
    for path, expected in seal["code_git_files"].items():
        raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", seal["SOURCE"] + ":" + path], cwd=ROOT)
        import hashlib
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected, "L_SOURCE_COMMIT")


def routing(contract, seal):
    require(contract["domain"] == seal["domain"], "L_ARTIFICIAL_REAL_DOMAIN_MISMATCH")
    require(contract["technical_SOURCE"] == seal["SOURCE"], "L_SOURCE_BINDING")
    require(contract["input_sha256"] == seal["input_files"], "L_INPUT_HASH_BINDING")
    require(contract["model_path"] == seal["model_path"] and contract["registry_path"] == seal["registry_path"], "L_INPUT_PATH_BINDING")


def issue_grant(contract_path, seal_path, namespace):
    contract = validate_contract(read(contract_path), active=True)
    seal = read(seal_path)
    verify_seal(seal)
    routing(contract, seal)
    require(sha(seal_path) == contract["technical_seal_sha256"], "L_SEAL_BINDING")
    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
    require(str(ns) == contract["output_namespace"] and not ns.exists(), "L_FRESH_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED")
    ns.mkdir(parents=True)
    grant = dict(kind="L_SCIENCE_ONE_SHOT" if contract["domain"] == "SAVED_H4" else "L_ARTIFICIAL_ONE_SHOT",
        namespace=str(ns), contract_sha256=sha(contract_path), seal_sha256=sha(seal_path),
        approval_sha256=contract["approval_sha256"], one_shot=True)
    grant["grant_id"] = digest(grant)
    save(ns / "contract.json", contract)
    save(ns / "seal.json", seal)
    save(ns / "grant.json", grant)
    return grant


def authority(namespace, *, worker=False):
    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
    contract = validate_contract(read(ns / "contract.json"), active=True)
    grant, seal = read(ns / "grant.json"), read(ns / "seal.json")
    kind = "L_SCIENCE_ONE_SHOT" if contract["domain"] == "SAVED_H4" else "L_ARTIFICIAL_ONE_SHOT"
    require(grant["kind"] == kind and grant["namespace"] == contract["output_namespace"] == str(ns), "L_GRANT_NAMESPACE_OR_KIND")
    require(grant["grant_id"] == digest({k: v for k, v in grant.items() if k != "grant_id"}), "L_GRANT_DIGEST")
    require(sha(ns / "contract.json") == grant["contract_sha256"] and sha(ns / "seal.json") == grant["seal_sha256"] == contract["technical_seal_sha256"], "L_GRANT_BINDING")
    require(grant["approval_sha256"] == contract["approval_sha256"], "L_APPROVAL_BINDING")
    require(not (ns / "STOP.json").exists(), "L_ALREADY_STOPPED")
    verify_seal(seal)
    routing(contract, seal)
    if worker:
        require(read(ns / "CONSUMED.json")["grant_id"] == grant["grant_id"] and (ns / "LAUNCH_CLAIM.json").is_file(), "L_WORKER_NOT_DISPATCHED")
    else:
        require(not (ns / "CONSUMED.json").exists(), "L_GRANT_ALREADY_USED")
    return contract, seal


def consume(namespace):
    contract, seal = authority(namespace)
    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
    save(ns / "CONSUMED.json", dict(grant_id=read(ns / "grant.json")["grant_id"], UTC=utc(), nonrefundable=True))
    save(ns / "LAUNCH_CLAIM.json", dict(pid=os.getpid(), UTC=utc()))
    return contract, seal


def witness(directory, command):
    # The C subreaper implementation is reused in an isolated witness process.
    # Adapt only the scope label before durable creation of our NEW receipt.
    original_save = C.save
    def scoped_save(path, value, **kwargs):
        if type(value) is dict and value.get("scope") == "NEW_C_WORKER_ONLY":
            value = dict(value, scope="NEW_L_WORKER_ONLY")
        return original_save(path, value, **kwargs)
    C.save = scoped_save
    try:
        return C.witness(directory, command)
    finally:
        C.save = original_save


def launch(namespace):
    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
    consume(ns)
    command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(ROOT / "scripts/run_h4_local_enclosure.py"), "--worker", str(ns)]
    witness_command = [sys.executable, "-B", str(ROOT / "scripts/run_h4_local_enclosure.py"),
                       "--witness", str(ns / "native"), "--command-json", json.dumps(command)]
    process = None
    try:
        process = subprocess.Popen(witness_command, start_new_session=True)
        code = process.wait()
        save(ns / "witness_exit.json", dict(exit_code=code, reaped=True, UTC=utc()))
        require(code == 0, "L_NATIVE_WORKER_FAILED")
        contract, seal = authority(ns, worker=True)
        require((ns / "worker_result.json").is_file(), "L_RESULT_MISSING")
        native = read(ns / "native" / "worker_native_exit.json")
        native_stop = read(ns / "native" / "STOP.json")
        require(native["exit_code"] == 0 and native["reaped"] is True
                and native_stop["all_owned_reaped"] is True, "L_NATIVE_RECEIPT_INCOMPLETE")
        result = read(ns / "worker_result.json")
        require(result["domain"] == contract["domain"] and result["precision_bits"] == 128
                and result["formal_certificate_accepted"] is False, "L_RESULT_SCOPE")
        verify_seal(seal)
        save(ns / "STOP.json", dict(status="L_LOCAL_EVIDENCE_SAVED_COMBINATION_BLOCKED", mandatory_STOP=True,
            native_exit=code, witness_reaped=True, formal_certificate_accepted=False,
            execution_authorized=False, grant_valid=False, dispatch_enabled=False, N_G_authorized=False, UTC=utc()))
    except BaseException as error:
        if process is not None and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            process.wait()
        if not (ns / "STOP.json").exists():
            save(ns / "STOP.json", dict(status="FAILED_NO_RETRY", error=repr(error), mandatory_STOP=True, UTC=utc()))
        raise


def worker(namespace):
    ns = Path(namespace).resolve()
    contract, seal = authority(ns, worker=True)
    save(ns / "WORKER_CLAIM.json", dict(pid=os.getpid(), UTC=utc()))
    try:
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("authorized_L_numeric", ROOT / "src/trotterlib/h4_local_enclosure.py")
        numeric = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(numeric)
        model, registry = read(contract["model_path"]), read(contract["registry_path"])
        artificial = contract["domain"] == "ARTIFICIAL"
        if artificial:
            require(model.get("test_fixture_domain") == "MANUALLY_SUPPLIED_ARTIFICIAL"
                    and type(model.get("n_qubits")) is int and 0 < model["n_qubits"] <= 2,
                    "L_ARTIFICIAL_FIXTURE_ONLY_NO_H4")
        plan = numeric.plan_from_saved(model, registry, artificial=artificial)
        budget = C.CallBudget(ns, LIMITS)
        # Recheck authority before and after the numerical stage. Before every
        # reservation, cheap flags/STOP/approval binding are also checked.
        def before_call():
            current = validate_contract(read(ns / "contract.json"), active=True)
            require(digest(current) == digest(contract) and not (ns / "STOP.json").exists(), "L_AUTHORITY_CHANGED_DURING_RUN")
        result = numeric.diagnose(plan, budget, emit=lambda name, record: save(ns / name, record),
                                  authorize_before_call=before_call)
        authority(ns, worker=True)
        save(ns / "worker_result.json", result)
        save(ns / "worker_STOP.json", dict(status=result["status"], formal_certificate_accepted=False, mandatory_STOP=True, UTC=utc()))
    except BaseException as error:
        if not (ns / "worker_STOP.json").exists():
            save(ns / "worker_STOP.json", dict(status="FAILED_PARTIALS_PRESERVED_NO_RETRY", error=repr(error), mandatory_STOP=True, UTC=utc()))
        raise

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""L one-shot runner; grant, launch and numerical worker are separate actions.

No default execution. This implementation-stage SOURCE ships only an inactive
contract, never an issued scientific grant or approval. Artificial tests call
the small numerical kernel directly with manually supplied fixtures.
"""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("local_L_controller", ROOT / "src/trotterlib/h4_local_control.py")
c = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(c)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    group.add_argument("--check-contract", type=Path)
    group.add_argument("--issue-grant", type=Path)
    group.add_argument("--launch", type=Path)
    group.add_argument("--worker", type=Path)
    group.add_argument("--witness", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--seal", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--namespace", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--command-json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.check_contract:
            c.validate_contract(c.read(args.check_contract))
            print(json.dumps(dict(status="VALID_INACTIVE_OR_ACTIVE_CONTRACT_NOT_EXECUTION", science_calls=0)))
        elif args.issue_grant:
            c.require(args.seal is not None and args.namespace is not None, "SEAL_AND_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED")
            c.issue_grant(args.issue_grant, args.seal, args.namespace)
        elif args.launch:
            c.launch(args.launch)
        elif args.worker:
            c.worker(args.worker)
        else:
            command = json.loads(args.command_json)
            c.require(type(command) is list and command and all(type(x) is str for x in command), "WITNESS_COMMAND")
            return c.witness(args.witness, command)
    except (ValueError, KeyError, OSError) as error:
        print("L_STOP: " + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
